title: Final Angular Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the angular distribution for the decay process, I proportional to sin^2(theta)(1 + alpha cos(theta)).

title: Final Parity Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the correct form of the angular distribution under the assumption of parity conservation, I proportional to (1 - cos^2(theta)).

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply conservation of angular momentum to determine the allowed values of l and m for the final state.

title: Wave Function Components
description: Important Criteria: The student should identify the contributions of the p and d wave functions in the final state of the decay.

title: Parity Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must analyze the parity of the initial and final states to determine the implications for the angular distribution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect application of angular momentum rules or miscalculating the parity of the states.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all mathematical expressions are consistent and correctly derived from the physical principles.

title: Unit Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
